problem_keywords: thermal loss through walls and ceilings
use_cases: Blanket insulation over ceiling joists or behind wall framing
Bulk thermal and acoustic insulation roll installed in commercial or residential cavities
retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation Higgins HBL
represents a bulk insulation blanket or roll product formerly identified in
distributor listings for Higgins Insulation. As no manufacturer technical data
sheet is currently published by Higgins Insulation under the standalone HBL
acronym, it corresponds to their commercial and residential polyester sound
blankets and building blankets. When specified, these rolls provide thermal
resistance and sound attenuation across cavity walls, roofs, and ceiling
assemblies.
